Regenerative agriculture tech, toprağı tüketmek yerine iyileştiren tarım uygulamalarını desteklemek için kullanılan sensör ve veri teknolojileridir.
A virtual, continuously updated model of a real physical object, process, or system, used to simulate and predict its behavior.

A digital twin is a software replica of something physical, a factory line, a building, a supply chain, or even a city, built from real-time sensor data so that changes in the physical original are reflected in the model, allowing teams to test scenarios or predict maintenance needs without disrupting the real system. It originated in manufacturing and aerospace engineering and has since spread to logistics, healthcare, and urban planning. For marketers in industrial, B2B, and technology sectors, the term gives a concrete way to describe efficiency and predictive-maintenance benefits to technical buyers.
A manufacturer building a digital twin of its production line can simulate the effect of a new machine before installing it physically, reducing the cost of trial and error.
IoT, predictive maintenance, simulation, smart city infrastructure
Digital twin technology, bir nesnenin, sürecin veya sistemin gerçek zamanlı verilerle güncellenen sanal bir kopyasını oluşturarak davranışını simüle eden teknolojidir.
A trend term describing the spread of self-operating, minimally supervised systems, such as vehicles and software agents, across many industries at once.

Autonomous Everything is a broad, informal industry label for the parallel rise of autonomous or semi-autonomous systems across multiple domains simultaneously, self-driving vehicles, autonomous drones and robots in warehouses, and increasingly AI agents that can complete multi-step digital tasks with limited human oversight. Rather than a single defined technology, it functions as shorthand for the direction several separate autonomy trends are moving together. For marketers, the term is more useful as framing for trend reports and thought leadership than as a specific product category, and claims of full autonomy in any given product should be checked carefully, since most current systems still require meaningful human oversight.

A trend report predicting that warehouses, delivery vehicles, and customer service software will all rely more heavily on autonomous systems within a few years might group these predictions under the label autonomous everything.
AI agents, autonomous vehicles, robotics, automation

Autonomous Everything, kendi kendine çalışan ve sınırlı insan denetimi gerektiren sistemlerin (otonom araçlar, robotlar, yapay zeka ajanları) birçok sektörde aynı anda yaygınlaşmasını tanımlayan bir eğilim terimidir.
The practice of shaping content so AI answer engines such as ChatGPT and Perplexity cite or recommend it, instead of ranking it as a plain search link.

GEO covers techniques for getting a brand mentioned or cited within AI-generated answers rather than only appearing as a link in search results. Researchers at Princeton, Georgia Tech, and IIT Delhi coined the term in a November 2023 paper, and it turned into a standard marketing discipline through 2025 as AI Overviews and chat assistants took share from classic search clicks. AI-referred web sessions grew more than 500 percent year over year in 2025, and visitors who arrive through AI search convert at several times the rate of ordinary organic traffic. Brands that skip GEO risk losing visibility as more answers get generated rather than clicked. The same practice is also marketed as AISO (AI Search Optimization), AIVO (AI Visibility Optimization), SAIO (Search AI Optimization) and GSO (Generative Search Optimization); when the target is AI shopping agents rather than answer engines, it is called AAIO (Agentic AI Optimization) or ACO (Agentic Commerce Optimization).
Search Engine Land, MarTech, and Digiday now run GEO how-to guides and vendor tool roundups as a regular beat, separate from classic SEO coverage.
Also called: AISO, AIVO, SAIO, GSO, AAIO, ACO. AEO, GAIO, LLM, AIO, LLMO, RAG
GEO, markaların ChatGPT ve Perplexity gibi yapay zeka arama araçlarının ürettiği yanıtlarda anılmasını veya önerilmesini sağlayan içerik uygulamalarını kapsar.
A shorthand with two competing meanings: Google's AI Overviews summary block in search results, or AI Optimization, structuring content for both readers and AI platforms.

AIO stands for either AI Overviews, Google's AI-generated summary block at the top of search results, or Artificial Intelligence Optimization, the practice of using AI tools to structure content for humans and AI platforms alike. Google launched AI Overviews in May 2024, and the acronym became common shorthand across marketing trade press through 2025. AI Overviews now appear in roughly 25 to 40 percent of Google searches and have cut organic click-through rates by as much as 61 percent where they show. The dual meaning is itself a recurring source of confusion, so marketers usually spell out which sense they intend when using the term with a team.
Google's own AI Overviews feature runs inside Search, and agencies such as Direct Agents and Contently publish 'SEO to AIO' transition guides.
AIO, Google aramalarının üstünde çıkan yapay zeka özet bloğunu ya da içeriği hem okuyucuya hem yapay zekaya göre düzenleme pratiğini ifade eder.
The discipline of building brand authority and structured content so large language models recognize a brand and surface it in conversational answers.

LLMO covers the work of establishing authority, structured content, and high information-gain material so large language models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity treat a brand as a credible source. It became a widely used marketing term through 2025, as GEO and AEO agencies split off a narrower, model-focused sub-discipline. Search Engine Land and 5W Public Relations both published standalone LLMO glossary pages in 2025, treating it as a distinct field rather than a synonym for GEO. Several agencies now budget for LLMO separately from classic SEO or GEO work, since it determines whether a brand gets mentioned inside a model's answer at all.
Search Engine Land and 5W Public Relations both published standalone LLMO glossary and guide pages in 2025, treating it as a named discipline separate from GEO.
LLMO, büyük dil modellerinin bir markayı güvenilir kaynak olarak tanıyıp yanıtlarında öne çıkarması için marka otoritesi ve yapılandırılmış içerik oluşturmayı kapsar.
An AI architecture in which a model retrieves relevant information from a knowledge base or the live web before generating its response.

RAG describes an AI setup where a model pulls in outside information before writing an answer, rather than relying only on what it learned during training. Facebook AI introduced the term in 2020-era NLP research, and it moved into everyday marketing vocabulary through 2025 as GEO, AEO, and LLMO practitioners began explaining it to clients as the mechanism behind AI search visibility. Google AI Overviews and Perplexity both use RAG-style retrieval before generating their summarized answers. Marketers now build content that is fresh, well-structured, and clearly sourced specifically so it can be retrieved by these systems.
Google AI Overviews and Perplexity both rely on RAG-style retrieval before generating their summarized answers.
LLM, AI Orchestrator, GEO, AEO, LLMO
RAG, bir yapay zeka modelinin yanıt üretmeden önce bilgi tabanından veya canlı web'den ilgili bilgiyi getirdiği bir mimaridir.
An open standard that lets AI models and agents connect to external tools, data sources, and platforms through one consistent interface.

MCP is an open standard Anthropic released in November 2024 so AI models and agents can plug into external tools and data sources without a custom integration for each one. Martech vendors covering analytics, CDPs, and ad platforms have moved quickly to add MCP support, since it is what lets a marketer query campaign data or trigger a workflow directly from a conversational AI tool. Trade coverage from Digiday and MarTech tracked marketing-specific adoption through 2025. It is becoming foundational plumbing for agentic marketing workflows across the stack.
Supermetrics, Knak, and AdSkate have published MCP integrations that let marketers pull reporting or run creative tests via conversational AI tools.
LLM, AI Orchestrator, A2A, AP2, UCP, ACP
MCP, yapay zeka modellerinin ve ajanların farklı araçlara ve veri kaynaklarına tek bir standart üzerinden bağlanmasını sağlar.

As of September 2026: introduced by Anthropic in November 2024; donated in December 2025 to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation, which now governs it as a vendor-neutral open standard.
An open standard that lets an AI agent complete a purchase on a buyer's behalf while the merchant stays the system of record for payment and tax.

ACP is an open standard that OpenAI and Stripe co-developed, with Meta and Salesforce also involved, and released under Apache 2.0 on September 29, 2025. It defines how an AI agent can complete a purchase for a buyer while the merchant remains responsible for payments, tax, and compliance. It powered ChatGPT's Instant Checkout with Etsy and Shopify brands including Glossier, Vuori, Spanx, and SKIMS, making it the first widely adopted standard for buying directly inside a chatbot. OpenAI retired the consumer-facing Instant Checkout feature in March 2026, but the industry still references the underlying ACP standard as the checkout-layer protocol.
ChatGPT Instant Checkout launched in September 2025 with Etsy and, later, Shopify merchants.
Conversational AI Commerce, DSP, AP2, UCP, x402
ACP, bir yapay zeka ajanının ödeme, vergi ve uyumluluktan satıcının sorumlu kaldığı bir düzende alıcı adına satın alma işlemini tamamlamasını tanımlar.

As of September 2026: launched by OpenAI and Stripe in September 2025. OpenAI retired Instant Checkout in ChatGPT in March 2026 and moved checkout back to merchants' own sites; the protocol itself remains in active development.
An open protocol that gives an AI agent a cryptographically signed permission slip from a human before it can spend money on that person's behalf.

AP2 is an open protocol Google announced in September 2025, developed together with more than 60 organizations including Mastercard, PayPal, and Coinbase. It works through a mandate, a cryptographically signed permission slip a human grants an AI agent before that agent can spend money on their behalf. Google positions AP2 as complementary to its A2A and MCP interoperability standards, together forming the emerging agentic commerce stack. Retail and commerce marketers need to understand it as shopping increasingly moves through AI agents rather than storefronts.
Google Cloud's September 2025 announcement listed Adyen, American Express, Mastercard, PayPal, and Coinbase as founding partners.
Conversational AI Commerce, ACP, UCP, x402, MCP, A2A
AP2, bir yapay zeka ajanının kişi adına harcama yapabilmesi için önce imzalı bir yetki belgesi almasını zorunlu kılar.

As of October 2026: announced by Google in September 2025 with more than 60 partners, including Mastercard, PayPal and Coinbase. On April 28, 2026, Google donated AP2 to the FIDO Alliance, which now governs it as a platform-agnostic, community-led standard.
An open-source standard that gives AI agents and merchant stores a shared language so shoppers can add items to cart from within Search, Gemini, YouTube, or Gmail.

UCP is an open-source standard Google released in January 2026, co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, and Walmart. It gives AI agents and merchant stores a common language so a shopper can add a product to a cart from inside Search, Gemini, YouTube, or Gmail. It is compatible with AP2 for payments and with A2A and MCP for agent communication, positioning it as Google's flagship answer to agentic shopping. Retail and performance marketers in Google-Ads-heavy markets need to know what merchant integration it requires.
Google Shopping's Universal Cart feature launched alongside UCP in January 2026, rolling out first to US merchants with Canada, Australia, and UK to follow by end of 2026.
Conversational AI Commerce, DSP, ACP, AP2, x402, MCP, A2A
UCP, alışveriş yapanların Search, Gemini, YouTube veya Gmail içinden sepete ürün eklemesini sağlayan ortak bir standarttır.
As of September 2026: announced by Google in January 2026 at NRF, co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target and Walmart.
An open standard that lets AI agents built by different vendors discover each other, delegate tasks, and coordinate work across company boundaries.

A2A is an open standard Google announced in April 2025 and now governed by the Linux Foundation. It lets AI agents from different vendors discover one another, hand off tasks, and coordinate work across company and platform boundaries. As martech stacks add agents for campaign optimization, creative generation, and reporting, A2A is the interoperability layer that keeps those agents from operating in isolated silos. Google's launch listed more than 50 founding partners, growing to over 150 supporters within a year.
GrowthLoop has described a 'Compound Marketing' vision built on A2A agent collaboration.
AI Orchestrator, LLM, MCP, AP2, ACP, UCP
A2A, farklı sağlayıcıların yapay zeka ajanlarının birbirini bulup görev devrederek şirket sınırları arasında birlikte çalışmasını sağlar.

As of October 2026: launched by Google in April 2025 and donated to the Linux Foundation in June 2025; on August 17, 2026, A2A became a hosted project of the Agentic AI Foundation, the same body that governs MCP; supported by more than 150 partner organizations.
A C-suite executive responsible for an organization's AI roadmap, guardrails, cross-functional AI teams, and measurement of AI-driven outcomes.

A CAIO sits on the executive team and owns an organization's AI roadmap, guardrails, and the coordination of AI work across departments. The role spread quickly as companies scaled generative AI: IBM's 2026 CEO Study, based on about 2,000 CEOs in 33 countries, found that 26 percent of organizations had a CAIO in 2025 and 76 percent in 2026. Marketing leaders increasingly partner with a CAIO on AI governance and tooling decisions.
IBM's 2026 CEO Study reported CAIO adoption rising from 26 percent of organizations in 2025 to 76 percent in 2026.
CAIO, bir kuruluşun yapay zeka yol haritasından, kurallarından ve departmanlar arası ekiplerden sorumlu üst düzey yöneticidir.
TikTok Shop's automated advertising campaign type that controls bidding, targeting, and creative distribution across the whole platform in a single campaign.

GMV Max is TikTok Shop's automated campaign format that handles bidding, audience targeting, and creative distribution platform-wide, attributing paid, organic, and affiliate sales to one automated campaign. It became mandatory for TikTok Shop advertising in September 2025, which means brands and agencies running TikTok Shop ads no longer have a manual-campaign alternative to plan around. Early adopters report roughly 30 percent higher GMV compared with manual Video Shopping Ads. Gross Merchandise Value itself is an older e-commerce metric; what is new is the mandatory automated campaign product built around it.
TikTok's official 'GMV Max One-Sheet 2025' advertiser guide documents the format for advertisers.
GMV Max, TikTok Shop'ta teklif, hedefleme ve reklam dağıtımını tek bir otomatik kampanyada birleştiren zorunlu reklam formatıdır.
An open-source, privacy-first identity framework that turns first-party data such as an email into a hashed identifier for targeted advertising without third-party cookies.

UID2 is an open-source identity framework, championed by The Trade Desk, that converts first-party data such as an email address into a hashed and salted identifier so advertisers can target without third-party cookies. The technology itself predates the last two years, but it became the de facto industry standard identity solution through 2025 and 2026, after Google abandoned its Privacy Sandbox cookie-replacement effort in late 2025. New adopters in that period include Roku, Experian, and Perion. Any programmatic buy made outside walled gardens now runs into UID2 as the leading open-web alternative.
Perion Network announced UID2 adoption via The Trade Desk in March 2025, and Urban Science rolled out UID2 for automotive targeting in 2026.
Identity Graph (ID Graph), Deterministic Matching, First-Party Data, PAIR, PETs
UID2, üçüncü taraf çerez kullanmadan hedefli reklam yapabilmek için e-posta gibi birinci taraf veriyi karma bir kimliğe dönüştürür.
As of September 2026: in active use. Google retired its Privacy Sandbox APIs in October 2025, which keeps first-party identity solutions like UID2 relevant.
A statistical measurement method that correlates aggregate spend by channel with aggregate business outcomes using regression, without cookies or user-level tracking.

MMM uses regression to compare aggregate spend across channels against aggregate business results, without relying on cookies, device IDs, or any user-level tracking. The technique itself is decades old, but it returned to mainstream marketing practice through 2025 and 2026 as the primary privacy-era measurement method, following continued signal loss and the cancellation of Google's Privacy Sandbox. An eMarketer and TransUnion survey found 46.9 percent of US marketers planned to invest more in MMM, with 27.6 percent naming it their single most reliable measurement method, ahead of multi-touch attribution. Free open-source tools such as Google's Meridian and Meta's Robyn have lowered the cost of entry.
Google's Meridian and Meta's Robyn are free open-source MMM tools that have lowered the cost of entry for marketers.
MMM, çerez veya kullanıcı bazlı takip olmadan kanal harcamalarını toplam iş sonuçlarıyla regresyon yoluyla ilişkilendiren bir ölçüm yöntemidir.
Content a brand commissions from a social media creator, blending the creator's voice with brand messaging while the brand owns and controls it.

CGC is content a brand pays a creator to make, mixing the creator's own voice with brand messaging, but the brand owns it and controls where it runs, unlike organic user-generated content. Brands increasingly separate CGC from UGC in briefs and contracts because it grants usage rights and placement control while keeping an authentic creator voice. It became a standardized budget line in creator marketing through 2025 and 2026 as the creator economy matured. Digiday's 2025 coverage tracked brands' growing investment in CGC specifically, distinct from organic UGC spend.
Digiday's 2025 coverage documented brands' growing investment specifically in creator-generated content as distinct from organic UGC.
CGC, bir markanın bir içerik üreticisinden ücret karşılığında ürettirdiği ama sahipliğini ve kontrolünü elinde tuttuğu içeriktir.
A marketing workflow in which a marketer describes the desired outcome, tone and audience in plain language, and AI tools handle the execution: copy, landing pages, ad variants and segmentation.

Vibe marketing takes its name from vibe coding, a term Andrej Karpathy coined in February 2025 for writing software by describing intent to an AI model rather than writing code by hand. Marketers adapted the idea through 2025 and 2026: instead of briefing a creative team or building assets by hand, a marketer states the goal and feel of a campaign in natural language, and AI tools generate and iterate the actual deliverables. eMarketer and Advertising Week both documented the practice spreading through small and mid-sized marketing teams in 2026, and MarTech noted related search interest growing sharply over the same period.

eMarketer reported marketers using AI tools to build audience connections and content at scale from a plain-language brief, and Advertising Week described how Klaviyo's Jamie Domenici applies the approach to his own campaign work.
Vibe Coding, Prompt Marketing, AI Orchestrator

Vibe marketing, bir pazarlamacının istenen sonucu, tonu ve hedef kitleyi sade bir dille tarif etmesi, metin, açılış sayfası, reklam varyasyonu ve segmentasyon gibi uygulama işini ise yapay zeka araçlarının üstlenmesidir.
The practical line, in a given task or purchase journey, between what a brand lets AI agents handle on their own and what it keeps in human hands.

Former OpenAI Head of Go-to-Market Zack Kass uses the automation boundary to describe where AI agents take over navigation and decisions in a customer journey, and where a brand still needs direct human attention. He frames the boundary as moving over time, set by risk, value and what customers find acceptable rather than by what technology can technically do. Kass has presented the idea in talks tied to his book The Next Renaissance, including an August 2026 appearance on MMA's Decoding AI for Marketing podcast.

In the August 25, 2026 episode of MMA's Decoding AI for Marketing podcast, recorded live at MMA's CMO & CEO Summit, Zack Kass discussed how marketers can locate their brand's place relative to customers' automation boundary as AI becomes infrastructure for more of the purchase journey.
HITL (Human in the Loop), Agentic AI, AAIO (Agentic AI Optimization)
Otomasyon sınırı, bir markanın belirli bir görevde veya satın alma yolculuğunda yapay zeka ajanlarına bıraktığı kısım ile insan elinde tuttuğu kısım arasındaki pratik çizgidir.
Share of Model is an AI visibility metric that measures how often a brand is mentioned or cited by one or more LLMs as a share of total category brand mentions.

The metric is credited to Jack Smyth and Tom Roach and is positioned as the AI-era successor to Share of Voice. It is calculated as brand mentions divided by total category mentions, multiplied by 100, using a fixed set of prompts run across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Several vendors, including Profound, Conductor and Semrush, now automate this calculation, giving marketing teams a direct KPI for AI answer presence.
NameSilo published "What is Share of Model: A KPI for 2026," and Symphonic Digital published "Share of Model: The Essential Marketing Metric for the AI Era."
Share of Voice (SOV), LLM Share of Voice
Share of Model, bir markanın kategori içindeki toplam yapay zeka yanıt anımlarına oranla ChatGPT, Gemini ve Perplexity gibi büyük dil modellerinde ne sıklıkla anıldığını ölçer.
llms.txt is a proposed plain-text file, similar in spirit to robots.txt or an XML sitemap, meant to help large language models find and prioritize a site's most important content.

Jeremy Howard of fast.ai and Answer.AI proposed the file in September 2024, and SEO trade press, including Search Engine Land and Ahrefs, has discussed it since as a low-effort AI-readiness step. Adoption stays low even so, at about 10 percent of a 300,000-domain sample cited by Ahrefs, and Google's Gary Illyes stated in July 2025 that Google does not support or plan to support it. Large empirical studies cited by these sources found no measurable AI-citation uplift from adding the file as of 2025 to 2026.
Search Engine Land published "Meet llms.txt, a proposed standard for AI website content crawling" (2024), and Ahrefs published "What Is llms.txt, and Should You Care About It?"
llms.txt, büyük dil modellerinin bir sitenin en önemli içeriğini bulup önceliklendirmesine yardımcı olması amaçlanan, robots.txt benzeri bir düz metin dosyası önerisidir.
E-E-A-T is Google's content quality framework, used in its Search Quality Rater Guidelines, that now also functions as a de facto AI-citation quality signal.

Google added the second "E," for Experience, to the older E-A-T framework on December 15, 2022. A BrightEdge study cited in 2025 to 2026 coverage found that 58 percent of pages that lost traffic in 2024 lacked strong E-E-A-T elements, especially clear authorship. Google's September 11, 2025 Search Quality Rater Guidelines update refined YMYL evaluation and reinforced the framework's weight, and marketers now treat it as relevant to both classic SEO and AI Overview or LLM citation eligibility.
WebProNews published "Google's 2025 Search Guidelines Update Boosts YMYL, E-A-T for SEO," and multiple agencies published 2025 to 2026 guides on applying E-E-A-T.
E-E-A-T, Google'ın içerik kalitesini değerlendirdiği ve artık yapay zeka yanıtlarında kaynak gösterilme olasılığını da etkileyen deneyim, uzmanlık, otorite ve güvenilirlik çerçevesidir.
Agent Experience is the discipline of designing a brand's site, docs, product feeds, pricing and schema so AI agents, not only human users, can discover, read and act on them accurately.

It is framed as the agent-era counterpart to UX, and the concept was articulated through 2025 before going mainstream in marketing and CMO commentary through 2026, including a February 2026 Forbes piece. As AI agents from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot increasingly research and even buy on a consumer's behalf, brands that are hard for an agent to parse risk becoming invisible in agent-mediated discovery and purchase decisions. Note that AX has a separate, unrelated expansion in customer-service tooling, where it refers to the human contact-center agent's own experience; the marketing-relevant sense here is about AI agents, and the two should be distinguished by context.
Forbes reported companies adding AX ownership to a Director of Web Strategy role, with a dedicated AX lead hired within 6 to 12 months.

Agent Experience (AX), bir markanın site, doküman, ürün akışı, fiyatlandırma ve şema verisini yalnızca insan kullanıcılar için değil AI ajanlarının doğru okuyup işlem yapabilmesi için tasarlama disiplinidir.

Trusted Agent Protocol is an open specification, co-developed by Visa and Cloudflare, that attaches cryptographically signed identity headers to AI agent web requests so a merchant can verify the request comes from a known, accountable shopping agent rather than an anonymous bot.

Visa and Cloudflare launched TAP on October 14, 2025, with 12 launch partners including Shopify, Stripe, Microsoft and Coinbase, and by early 2026 the protocol had more than 100 partners with a commercial launch targeted for Q1 2026. Marketers and e-commerce teams need to stop blocking legitimate AI shopping agents as bot traffic while still filtering out scrapers and fraud, and TAP is becoming the plumbing that lets agent-driven traffic reach checkout without being firewalled.
Visa and Cloudflare launched TAP on October 14, 2025 with 12 launch partners, scaling to 100+ partners by early 2026 with commercial launch targeted for Q1 2026.

TAP, bir AI ajanının web isteğine kriptografik olarak imzalanmış kimlik başlıkları ekleyerek satıcının bu isteğin gerçek ve hesap verebilir bir alışveriş ajanından geldiğini doğrulamasını sağlayan bir protokoldür.

As of October 2026: launched by Visa with Cloudflare in October 2025 with roughly a dozen launch partners, including Shopify, Stripe, Microsoft and Coinbase; by early 2026 Visa's broader agentic-commerce ecosystem, which TAP is part of, had grown past 100 partners, with Fiserv and Akamai among newer additions.
Human in the Loop is an operating principle where a trained person reviews or approves higher-risk AI agent actions, such as sends, payments, deletions or published content, before they execute.

It is an established machine-learning term that became a mainstream marketing-ops governance pattern through 2025 to 2026 as agentic marketing scaled. As marketing teams deploy AI agents for content, campaigns and even spend decisions, HITL separates safe "read" actions an agent can do freely from "write" actions that need sign-off, and it also works as a trust signal to consumers wary of unlabeled AI content. In marketing it usually means a person reviews and edits AI-generated campaigns, copy or assets before they are published.
A content team lets AI draft email variants but requires an editor to approve every version before it is sent.
HITL, gönderim, ödeme, silme veya yayınlama gibi riskli AI ajan eylemlerinin gerçekleşmeden önce eğitimli bir kişi tarafından incelenip onaylanmasını öngören bir çalışma ilkesidir.
A server-to-server method for sending conversion event data directly from an advertiser's server to ad platforms, bypassing browser pixels and cookies.

CAPI covers Meta's Conversions API and equivalents at Google, TikTok, and Snap. It restores signal lost to iOS privacy changes, ad blockers, and cookie restrictions by sending event data server to server instead of relying on a browser pixel. As of 2026, marketers treat CAPI as a baseline requirement rather than an advanced optimization, since it improves match rates and automated bidding accuracy. The most common setup pairs Meta CAPI with the Meta Pixel for deduplicated event matching.
Meta Conversions API paired with the Meta Pixel for deduplicated, more accurate event matching, as widely documented in 2026 implementation guides.
CAPI, tarayıcı tabanlı pikseli atlayarak dönüşüm verisini reklamverenin sunucusundan doğrudan reklam platformlarına gönderen bir yöntemdir.
IAB Europe's updated consent-signaling standard that makes proof of vendor disclosure a mandatory, technical part of the consent string.

TCF 2.3 was released on 19 June 2025 and requires the Disclosed Vendors section of the TC string, giving technical rather than only policy-based proof that vendors were disclosed to users. The migration deadline is 28 February 2026; after that date, strings built on TCF 2.2 become technically invalid. Non-compliant ad requests then default to Google's Limited Ads mode, which industry estimates say can cut programmatic revenue by 40 to 60 percent.
Google Ads announced TCF 2.3 compliance becomes mandatory 28 Feb 2026 for all advertisers serving ads in Europe, per Dataslayer's 2026 briefing.
TCF 2.3, satıcıların kullanıcılara gerçekten bildirildiğinin teknik kanıtını onay dizesine zorunlu kılan güncellenmiş bir onay standardıdır.
A browser-level signal that automatically tells websites not to sell or share a visitor's personal information for targeted advertising.

GPC works as a universal opt-out mechanism built into the browser rather than a setting a user configures on each site. Twelve US states require GPC compliance by 1 January 2026, including California, Colorado, and Texas, and California's CPPA voted in August 2026 to formally name GPC inside CCPA regulations. Joint enforcement sweeps began in September 2025, when Connecticut, California, and Colorado Attorneys General sent enforcement letters to businesses not honoring the signal.
Connecticut, California, and Colorado Attorneys General jointly sent enforcement letters in September 2025 to businesses not honoring GPC opt-out signals.
GPC, bir ziyaretçinin kişisel verisinin hedefli reklam için satılmamasını veya paylaşılmamasını web sitelerine otomatik olarak bildiren tarayıcı düzeyinde bir sinyaldir.
An EU regulation setting mandatory rules for online platforms on content moderation, ad transparency, and targeted-advertising disclosure.

DSA entered force in 2022-2023, but its ad-specific codes of conduct and marketer compliance activity concentrated through 2024-2025. Article 46 requires ad-supply-chain traceability, so marketers targeting EU users must follow these rules or face fines. A German advertising federation response to the EDPB's October 2025 public consultation discussed the DSA's advertising transparency requirements in detail.
The DSA's advertising transparency requirements were discussed in an October 2025 EDPB public consultation response from ZAW (German advertising federation).
DSA, çevrimiçi platformlar için içerik denetimi, reklam şeffaflığı ve hedefli reklam bildirimi konusunda zorunlu kurallar getiren bir AB düzenlemesidir.
An EU regulation that limits the economic power of designated gatekeeper platforms, such as restricting self-preferencing and cross-service data combination.

DMA entered force in 2022-2023, and gatekeeper compliance changes affecting marketer workflows landed through 2024-2025. Gatekeeper obligations affect how marketers can target and measure on platforms like Google and Meta in the EU. Repeat violations by gatekeepers can trigger fines up to 20 percent of global turnover, which reshapes the targeting options available to marketers.
Fasken's July 2025 overview explains how DMA gatekeeper rules interact with DSA advertising-transparency rules for EU-facing marketers.
DMA, örneğin kendi hizmetini kayırma veya hizmetler arası veri birleştirmeyi kısıtlayarak belirlenmiş bekçi platformların ekonomik gücünü sınırlayan bir AB düzenlemesidir.
Turkey's national database where businesses store and manage consumer consents for commercial electronic messages such as SMS, email, and calls.

İYS operates separately from, and alongside, KVKK consent for processing personal data. The system was established under Turkey's e-commerce law between roughly 2015 and 2020. Since 31 March 2025, approval and rejection operations can only be carried out through Official İYS Integrators, which tightens compliance requirements for CRM and lifecycle marketing teams. Turkish marketers must obtain İYS approval before sending any commercial message, on top of KVKK consent.
DSR Belgelendirme's 2026 guide documents current İYS application steps via MERSİS number and e-signature.
İYS, işletmelerin SMS, e-posta ve arama gibi ticari elektronik iletiler için tüketici onaylarını sakladığı ve yönettiği ulusal bir veri tabanı sistemidir.
A Google Ads Search campaign feature that combines broad-match query matching, AI-generated headline and description customization, and Final URL Expansion.

AI Max launched in 2025 after an earlier private beta called Search Max, and rolled out fully by the third quarter of that year. It expanded into Dynamic Search Ads upgrades through 2026. Google's own data reports roughly 14 percent more conversions at a similar cost per acquisition, which is why PPC marketers now need to know the term when planning Search budgets.
Google's own blog post 'Unlock next-level performance with AI Max for Search campaigns' documents the feature's rollout.
AI Max, geniş eşlemeli sorgu eşleştirmeyi, yapay zeka ile oluşturulan başlık ve açıklama uyarlamasını ve Final URL Expansion'ı birleştiren bir Google Ads Arama kampanyası özelliğidir.

An advertising network run by a company with first-party shopper or transaction data, such as a retailer or marketplace, that sells ad space to brands; the term extends the retail media idea beyond the largest retailers.

CMN widens the retail media network model beyond players like Amazon and Walmart to other retailers and marketplaces that hold direct shopper data. The term circulated among ad tech vendors from around 2023 and became common in marketer trade press in 2025-2026. Marketers now evaluate a wider set of CMN partners as first-party-data ad inventory, and financial platforms run a related variant, FMN.

A Forbes Agency Council article (April 2026), "Commerce Media Networks: The Next Frontier In Brand Advertising," describes CMNs as retailer and e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, Target and Instacart that sell ads based on direct shopper data.
Retail Media Network (RMN), Retail Media Platform (RMP), Commerce Media, First-Party Data

CMN, perakendeci veya pazaryeri gibi birinci taraf alışverişçi verisine sahip bir şirketin markalara reklam alanı sattığı ticaret medyası ağıdır; retail media fikrini en büyük perakendecilerin ötesine taşır.
Organic content such as LinkedIn posts and short-form video that a company's own employees create, rather than its marketing team or paid influencers.

EGC was named and tracked as a distinct content category through 2025 trade press. As user-generated content and influencer costs rise, and audiences distrust polished brand content, marketers are formalizing employee advocacy and EGC programs. Forbes and other 2025 sources argue that EGC reads as more authentic than branded content.
Forbes Agency Council (Feb 2025), "The Hidden Power Of Employee-Generated Content," and multiple 2025 agency guides positioning EGC as a named content category alongside UGC.
EGC, pazarlama ekibi veya ücretli içerik üreticileri yerine bir şirketin kendi çalışanlarının oluşturduğu LinkedIn gönderileri ve kısa video gibi organik içeriktir.
A C-suite role that owns growth across the funnel, acquisition, conversion, and retention, by combining marketing, product, and data functions.

CGO is distinct from a CMO, who focuses on brand and demand, and a CRO, who focuses on near-term revenue execution. Adoption accelerated markedly in 2024-2025, and secondary sources citing a Gartner report state nearly 40 percent of Fortune 500 companies now have a CGO, up from about 15 percent two years earlier. Low-quality content made in bulk with generative AI, published to fill feeds and collect views or ad money rather than to inform or entertain.

AI slop is the flood of cheap AI-generated images, videos, articles and posts that now fills social feeds, video platforms and search results. It is usually made fast, at scale and with little human checking, so it tends to be repetitive, wrong or strange. The word 'slop' first meant liquid waste or scraps fed to pigs. Its use for low-grade AI output apparently began around 2022, after AI image generators were released, among commenters on 4chan, Hacker News and YouTube. British programmer Simon Willison was an early champion of the term: in a blog post on 8 May 2024 he argued for using it and credited a tweet that said 'slop' was becoming a term of art. Merriam-Webster and the American Dialect Society both named 'slop' their 2025 Word of the Year. It is a close relative of workslop: workslop is polished-looking AI output inside a company that leaves colleagues with extra work, while AI slop is published to public feeds and platforms. For advertisers the term matters in two ways: ads can run next to slop, and AI-made creative can be read as slop by audiences, so media plans need adjacency checks and creative needs a human quality bar.

In November 2024, Coca-Cola released AI-generated holiday commercials that were met with backlash from viewers and artists. The practice of making AI-assisted work look fully human-made, through handcrafted styling, named creators or behind-the-scenes stories, while hiding how much AI actually did.

Humanwashing is the mirror image of AI washing: instead of overstating AI to borrow a tech halo, a brand understates AI to protect an authenticity halo. Business ethicist Peter Seele introduced 'humanwashing of machines' in a March 2021 post, and in 2022 formalized it with Andreea Scorici and Mario Schultz in AI & Society as the deceptive use of a machine's human-like appearance to mislead people about what it can really do. Marketing writers then took the word over for brand and creative work: the WHAT'S ANU newsletter in December 2025, followed by agencies such as Flux+Form in 2026, where it now means passing off AI-generated content as human craft. The risk for marketers is trust: when undisclosed AI use surfaces, the brand is judged less on the AI itself than on the concealment.

In August 2025 J.Crew posted AI-generated images styled as vintage catalog shots on Instagram without saying they were AI-made. After the newsletter Blackbird Spyplane exposed them on 26 August 2025, the brand edited its captions to credit an 'AI photographer' rather than stating plainly that the images were AI-generated.

The question sits in the territory of MMA's AI Leadership Think Tank (ALTT, formerly the AI Leadership Coalition), which runs a Responsible AI working group and the Responsible AI Innovation Lab (RAIL), a source of guidelines, templates and checklists for ethical AI use in marketing. A marketing or advertising technology stack assembled from many separately bought tools that were bolted together over time and do not work as one system.

A Frankenstack is what a marketing team ends up with when each department buys its own tools for data, media buying, creative and reporting, and the pieces are later wired together with manual work, exports and custom connectors. The word blends Frankenstein and tech stack: a system built from mismatched parts that runs, but badly. It comes from the martech world. The earliest verifiable use found is a 31 March 2015 chiefmartec.com post by its editor Scott Brinker, who wrote that the phrase had entered the industry's lingo; six weeks later, in a CIO.com interview, he called it a 'humorous label' for stacks that grew out of marketing silos. No single coiner is known. In 2025 and 2026 the term returned in adtech coverage as teams started adding AI tools and agents on top of these stacks. Before a team adds another AI tool, it pays to check whether the tool connects the existing data and workflows or just adds one more part to the stack.

A brand strategy in which a fashion company acts like an entertainment business, building fandom through content, music, live experiences and licensing instead of relying on ad campaigns alone.

Fashiontainment treats a clothing brand as a source of stories and cultural moments, not only of products. The brand co-produces shows, partners with artists, runs live events and designs collections with the talent, so fans meet it inside the entertainment they already follow. The word blends fashion and entertainment. Gap Inc. CEO Richard Dickson uses the word to describe the company's strategy. Gap Inc. now uses Fashiontainment as the name of the platform Kaufman leads. Like edutainment and archivetainment, it is built by joining a field's name with 'entertainment'. For marketers, the test is whether a partnership builds a lasting fan relationship across content, stores and product, or is simply a celebrity campaign with a new name.

It is the first collaboration under Gap Inc.'s Fashiontainment platform.
